name: subagent-router
description: Before each subagent starts, Haiku reads its task and picks the cheapest model that can do it (Sonnet at least for code edits, Fable only with your OK); a band above the prompt shows each pick and the estimated saving.

ceiling.title: Highest model the router may pick
ceiling.description: opus (default): every agent is judged on its own, up to Opus (Fable may pass it, with your OK). sonnet: never above Sonnet. parent: never above the spawning session's own model.

respectExplicit.title: Keep a model the spawning call already chose
respectExplicit.description: On: an Agent call that passes its own model is left alone. Off: the router decides every spawn.

showNotice.title: Show a note under each routed Agent call
showNotice.description: One line: the model picked and why.

allowFable.title: Let Haiku pick Fable for the hardest tasks
allowFable.description: On (default): Haiku may pick Fable 5.2, past the Opus ceiling, and you are always asked first (Use Fable, Use Opus, or Cancel this agent). Off: the router never picks Fable.
